Section 6

The integrated prototype

The platform, clickable, across five lenses. One self-contained page, with no server and no network calls, and it works on a phone.

Open the integrated prototype

Front door, Member, Club, Programme and Federation lenses, 58 screens. Switch lens from the bar at the top.

How to read it

The prototype is strong evidence of a story and weak evidence of a rule (D41). It shows most of the journeys a member, an officer or a staff member walks, end to end. It is thin on the logic behind the screens. For a rule, the by-laws and the Decisions Register come first, and the prototype comes after them.

People, households and money in it are fictional.

Where it disagrees with the record

The prototype was built before some decisions were made, and it has been left as it was rather than quietly edited to agree (D48). It will be re-framed later.

  • It still shows the four "rails" (youth pipeline, advocacy, heritage, Palestine-direct) on the member's My pathway screen. The record now uses the four branches: Education, Leadership, Heritage and Care (D38).
  • Its Programme lens groups programmes the old way (Medical, Cultural, Leadership, Educational, Camp, Convention), not by branch. The tours below regroup them by branch.
  • The family tree appears as one programme among nineteen. It is now the roots beneath all four branches (D30, D38).
